summary: Built ApprovalReviewPage: the Approver's full contract/approval review screen showing Contract Title, Contract Type, Contract Value, Counterparty Name, Key Terms Summary, Deviations from Standard, AI Risk Score (labelled 'AI Suggestion – for reference only') and Approval Matrix Step, matching the gradient-banner + stat-strip + two-card + deviations layout in the TARGET DESIGN. Decision panel (ApprovalActionsPanel) enforces mandatory Comments on Reject/Send Back, optional on Approve, and disables all three actions with the exact blocking copy when the step is not yet reached in sequence. DelegateModal lets an eligible Approver assign a time-bound Delegate from the tenant's Approver-role users, surfacing backend eligibility/ownership errors inline. ApprovalHistoryTab renders the immutable, 7-year-retained history log. Wired to GET /approvals/{id}, POST /approvals/{id}/actions, POST /approvals/{id}/delegate and GET /approvals/{id}/history only (new approvalsService.js + four hooks), with loading/empty/error(+retry)/populated states, a role-gated access-denied screen for roles outside the endpoint's contract, and 409-conflict handling that reloads state and shows the stale-state message. Verified with lint (clean), 54/54 unit tests passing (7 new in ApprovalReviewPage.test.jsx), a production build, and a Playwright screenshot against a temporary local mock of the four owned endpoints, compared side-by-side against design/IMG-2.png and IMG-3.png.

code_files.description: Typed client for the approval detail/actions/delegate/history endpoints this page owns (GET /approvals/{id}, POST .../actions, POST .../delegate, GET .../history); intentionally omits GET /api/v1/approvals (list), which belongs to ApprovalsListPage.
Fetches ApprovalResponse with loading/error/refetch state, per the module contract's hook signature.
Submits ApprovalActionRequest to POST /approvals/{id}/actions, per the module contract's hook signature.
Submits DelegateRequest to POST /approvals/{id}/delegate, per the module contract's hook signature.
Fetches ApprovalHistoryListResponse for the Approval History tab, per the module contract's hook signature.
Fetches tenant users holding the Approver role via GET /api/v1/users?role=APPROVER (an existing uc123-module endpoint/service), used to populate the Delegate To dropdown's eligible-user list.

Read-only gradient banner (Approval Matrix Step + AI Risk Score gauge), stat strip (Contract Value / Contract Type / Deviations Found / Steps Approved), Contract Details + Key Terms Summary cards, and a Deviations from Standard card labelled 'AI Suggestion – for reference only'.

Comments field plus Approve/Reject/Send Back buttons; blocks Reject/Send Back without Comments, blocks all three actions (with the exact 'waiting on an earlier approver' message) when approval.isStepActionable is false, and individually disables each button per approval.canApprove/canReject/canSendBack.

Delegate To dropdown (Approver-role tenant users, self excluded) with From/To date fields (DD/MM/YYYY, converted to ISO for the request); surfaces the backend's ineligible-delegate / Contract-Owner-exclusion error inline since ApprovalResponse carries no contractOwnerId for a client-side check.
Immutable list of ApprovalHistoryEntryResponse items (step, actor, action badge, comments quote, timestamp) with loading/empty/error(+retry) states.

Route-level PAGE assembling the four components above behind the repo's chrome (breadcrumb/header), gated to the GET endpoint's four allowed roles, with loading/empty/error/populated states, a header Delegate button (visible only when approval.canDelegate), and 409-conflict handling that refetches and shows the stale-state message for both actions and delegation.

Screen-level tests: populated render with AI-reference labelling, access-denied for a disallowed role (SIGNER), blocked Reject without Comments, successful Approve without Comments, disabled/blocked out-of-sequence step, Approval History rendering, and read-only Decision for a Contract Owner.
Added the /approvals/:approvalId route for the new page, alongside the existing routes (no existing route changed).

pr.title: feat(ui-gen): ApprovalReviewPage for contract approval decisions
pr.body: Implements ApprovalReviewPage (UC6-MF-001 and the UC6-AF/BR/FV stories listed in the task): an Approver's review screen for a contract's current approval step, with read-only AI-reference fields, Approve/Reject/Send Back with mandatory-comments and sequence enforcement, time-bound Delegate assignment, and an immutable Approval History tab. Calls only GET /approvals/{id}, POST /approvals/{id}/actions, POST /approvals/{id}/delegate and GET /approvals/{id}/history, matching the DTOs in the module contract exactly. See blockers for a story-vs-design conflict (Delegate panel visibility) and inferred, non-DTO UI behavior.

blockers: Story-vs-design contradiction (per the task's resolution rule, the story wins): design/IMG-2.png shows the 'Delegate Approval' panel (Delegate To dropdown + From/To dates) rendered inline on the page at all times, alongside the Decision card. But UC6-BR-008's acceptance criteria explicitly require 'the Delegate To field is only visible when the Approver selects Delegate... when the Approver has not selected Delegate, no delegation start/end date fields or Delegate To dropdown are shown', and the component is named DelegateModal (not an inline card) in both TASK.md and context.json. I implemented it as a true modal opened via a header '→ Delegate' button (shown only when approval.canDelegate), matching the story and the component's contractual name/shape rather than the always-visible inline card the screenshot depicts.

Inferred, non-DTO UI behavior derived from the design and the given fields, since no field for either exists in ApprovalResponse: (1) the 'Deviations Found' count on the stat strip is computed client-side by parsing the numbered-sentence structure of deviationsFromStandard (only counting markers that continue the running 1,2,3... sequence, to avoid matching incidental numbers like 'Net 30.' inside a sentence) — there is no deviationsCount field in the contract. (2) 'Steps Approved' (e.g. '1 of 3') is computed as approvalMatrixStepNumber − 1 of approvalMatrixTotalSteps, i.e. steps strictly before the current one, since ApprovalResponse has no explicit approved-step-count field.

DelegateModal cannot enforce the Contract Owner exclusion (UC6-BR-011) client-side because ApprovalResponse carries no contractOwnerId field to filter against; the dropdown offers every tenant user with the Approver role (minus the signed-in user) and relies on the backend's POST /approvals/{id}/delegate rejection (surfaced inline, per UC6-AF-005's exact error copy) to enforce eligibility and the Contract Owner exclusion.

Action-eligibility gating (who sees Approve/Reject/Send Back/Delegate at all) is driven by the backend's own isCurrentUserApprover / isCurrentUserActiveDelegate / canApprove / canReject / canSendBack / canDelegate flags on ApprovalResponse, combined with a role check (role === 'APPROVER') to mirror POST /actions and /delegate being APPROVER-only per their endpoint role lists. I did not additionally special-case UC6-BR-016's 'Tenant Admin who is also a named Approver can act' scenario, since the POST endpoints' role lists in this contract restrict those calls to APPROVER regardless of named-approver status — reconciling that would require a backend/contract change, not a frontend one.

GET /api/v1/approvals (the list endpoint) and GET/PUT /api/v1/approval-matrix-config, though listed in this task's 'API endpoints you must call' section (shared story IDs with ApprovalsListPage and the already-built ApprovalMatrixConfigPage), are intentionally not called from this page — they belong to those other tasks per the module contract's component-to-endpoint mapping and this task's 'What you own' section.
